title: Beyond Cut Balance: Spectral Sparsification of the Nonlinear Directed Laplacian
summary: Digraphs with constant cut balance admit nearly linear directed cut sparsifiers. This condition requires the total arc weights in the two directions of every cut to be within a constant factor of each other. We ask whether this condition also permits nearly linear spectral sparsification with respect to the energy of the nonlinear directed Laplacian. For a weighted digraph $G=(V,E,w)$, let \[ Q_G^+(x)=\sum_{(u,v)\in E}w_{uv}(x_u-x_v)_+^2, \qquad (t)_+:=\max\{t,0\}. \] This energy agrees with the outgoing-cut function on binary vectors.
